ai-chat-widget.title: Launcher and window placement (V1 to V3)
ai-chat-widget.description: Vectoria AI chat launcher shown in three placements over an Insights dashboard backdrop. A version switcher toggles V1 (top-nav icon, window top-right), V2 (bottom-right FAB), and V3 (top-nav icon, window bottom-right).

ai-chat-widget/surfaces/training-plan.ht.title: FAB surface: Training Plan
ai-chat-widget/surfaces/training-plan.ht.description: Learner training-plan page carrying the Fin chat FAB bottom-right, listing assigned items by urgency. Count tiles (Assigned, In progress, Overdue, Completed) top Overdue and Due soon sections with Resume/Start actions.

ai-chat-widget/surfaces/catalog.html.title: FAB surface: Catalog
ai-chat-widget/surfaces/catalog.html.description: Course catalog page hosting the Fin chat FAB bottom-right, with a search field, category filter chips, and card grid. Course cards carry category, title, meta, rating, and an Enroll button, with a grid/list view toggle.

assigned-training-wizard.title: Assigned Training Wizard
assigned-training-wizard.description: Full-page wizard for assigning training, opening on Select Training with search, filters, and a selection panel. A five-step stepper runs Select Training, Select Assignees, Scheduling, Optional Settings, and Review.

component-redesigns.html.title: Component Redesigns
component-redesigns.html.description: Interactive gallery of EHS LMS component redesign options, responsive to hover and click. It compares nav-item, launch-button, and card-tile variants like ghost buttons, left-border active states, and solid blue tiles.

Qualification-Builder/Manage-Qualificati.title: Manage Qualifications
Qualification-Builder/Manage-Qualificati.description: AG Grid list of qualifications with completion criteria, order, requirement count, status, and location columns. A create control offers Build with AI or Create manually; row actions raise deactivate and delete dialogs.

Qualification-Builder/Manage-Requirement.title: Manage Requirements
Qualification-Builder/Manage-Requirement.description: AG Grid list of requirements within the Qualifications area, with sortable columns and status indicators. Row names link into AI or manual requirement builders, and actions open a deactivate confirmation dialog.

Qualification-Builder/Manage-Activities..title: Manage Activities
Qualification-Builder/Manage-Activities..description: AG Grid list of learning activities that feed qualifications, with type and status columns. Create actions add activities or requirements; row links open Edit Activity or Learning Studio, plus deactivate/delete dialogs.

Qualification-Builder/Edit-Activity.html.title: Edit Activity
Qualification-Builder/Edit-Activity.html.description: Activity editor split into Details, Delivery, Attributes, and Attachments tabs. Covers activity version history, recomplete settings, thumbnail and attachment uploads, and an Edit in Learning Studio handoff.

Qualification-Builder/AI-Qualification-B.title: AI Qualification Builder
Qualification-Builder/AI-Qualification-B.description: Qualification builder pairing a program canvas with a conversational assistant panel. Canvas sections cover Requirements, Activities, and Settings, with a Generating Your Program state and add-existing pickers.

Qualification-Builder/Manual-Qualificati.title: Manual Qualification Builder
Qualification-Builder/Manual-Qualificati.description: Same qualification builder as the AI variant, minus the conversational panel, built manually. Editors add existing requirements and activities, configure Settings, and view the Qualification Audit History.

Qualification-Builder/AI-Requirement-Bui.title: AI Requirement Builder
Qualification-Builder/AI-Requirement-Bui.description: Requirement builder pairing an activities canvas with a conversational assistant panel. The panel drafts requirements from prompts, while Add Existing Activity inserts items directly.

Qualification-Builder/Manual-Requirement.title: Manual Requirement Builder
Qualification-Builder/Manual-Requirement.description: Manual requirement builder that defines a requirement by picking its activities, without the AI assistant. A Select Activities picker adds items, Share this requirement distributes it, and the Audit History logs changes.

location-nav.title: Location Navigation
location-nav.description: Administration Dashboard showing a redesigned location switcher that opens a clickable location tree. A 'Now viewing' indicator tracks the current scope above dashboard tiles like Compliance Rate and task panels.

Mobile App.title: Mobile App
Mobile App.description: Interactive mobile app prototype in a phone frame spanning 17 screens, from org lookup and sign-in to the learner home. A bottom tab bar (Home, Discover, Records, Profile) links My Training, course sections, and quizzes.

Report Redesigns/Report Redesign/V1/V1 S.title: Report Redesign V1 (Scheduling)
Report Redesigns/Report Redesign/V1/V1 S.description: Qualification Reporting redesign (v1) as report cards for Completion Status and Activity Exception. Each card offers date-preset filters, entity pickers, bar/line/pie toggles, and Schedule/Recipient delivery blocks.

Report Redesigns/Report Redesign/V2 With.title: Report Redesign V2 (Management Pages)
Report Redesigns/Report Redesign/V2 With.description: Qualification Reporting redesign (v2) that extends v1 with CRUD management pages for saved views and schedules. A Views & Schedules section lists Saved Views and Scheduled Reports with create, edit, and delete actions.

Report Redesigns/Tasklist Report.title: Tasklist Report
Report Redesigns/Tasklist Report.description: Insights Tasklist Report presenting task sign-off tracking in a filterable table. Columns cover task description, instructor and employee sign-off, and comments, with Report Filters and complete/incomplete status.

Report Redesigns/Table Breakpoints.title: Table Breakpoints Reference
Report Redesigns/Table Breakpoints.description: Reference documenting how the report table adapts across seven responsive breakpoints. Includes an interactive simulator, a side-by-side comparison, a column-width spec, and a five-stage scale of column shedding.

select-qualifications-modal.title: Select Qualifications Modal
select-qualifications-modal.description: Sizing spec for the Select Qualifications modal, previewing it at Large Desktop, Desktop, Tablet Landscape, and Mobile. Each preview shows qualification selection with Add Selected and Cancel, plus a breakpoint summary.
